items.why: The crouch loads the legs for the vault.
Airborne after the vault, the acrobat must land.
The acrobat lands clear of the scorch.
Grounded again, the acrobat can spin into a kick.
The staggered wizard throws a desperate ward.
Thrown through the air, the acrobat hits the pillar.
Braced on the pillar, the acrobat pushes off to recover.
Recovered, the acrobat can attack again.
Steady again, the wizard can cast.
The feint baits the wizard's bolt.
The acrobat flips away from the bolt.

intent.raw_query: 10 seconds anime fight scene: wizard versus acrobat in a moonlit bamboo courtyard

invariants.rule: no extra fighters beyond A and B
TWO fighter identities A and B never merge or duplicate
S16 output is uncompressed. The full envelope is projected; nothing is summarized, truncated, or dropped.
Marks, cracks and cut bamboo stay visible for the rest of the scene once made.
A spell effect starts at a hand, staff tip or declared focus, never from empty space.

Every airborne phase starts from a declared support contact and ends in a landing or a new contact.

items.action: Acrobat sprints across the flagstones toward the wizard, low and quick, gathering into a crouch.

causes.why: The crouch loads the legs for the vault.

items.label: run_in

items.action: Acrobat plants the right hand and vaults forward, body inverting overhead. NOT a jump straight up.

causes.why: Airborne after the vault, the acrobat must land.

items.label: vault

items.action: Wizard extends the right hand and fires a bolt at the vaulting acrobat; it misses and scorches the flagstones.

causes.why: The acrobat lands clear of the scorch.

items.label: cast_fire_bolt

items.action: Acrobat lands to the wizard's left in a deep crouch, both feet on the stone.

causes.why: Grounded again, the acrobat can spin into a kick.

items.label: land

items.action: Acrobat spins and drives the right heel into the wizard's chest. NOT a punch.

causes.why: The staggered wizard throws a desperate ward.

items.label: spinning_kick

items.action: Off balance, the wizard thrusts both palms; a force ward hurls the acrobat backward off the ground.

causes.why: Thrown through the air, the acrobat hits the pillar.

items.label: force_ward

items.action: Acrobat slams back-first into the stone pillar; the stone cracks behind the shoulders.

causes.why: Braced on the pillar, the acrobat pushes off to recover.

items.label: slam_pillar

items.action: Acrobat pushes off the cracked pillar and drops to both feet in a low guard, shaking off the hit.

causes.why: Recovered, the acrobat can attack again.

items.label: recover

items.action: Wizard steadies the stance and draws breath, hands rising back to a casting guard.

causes.why: Steady again, the wizard can cast.

items.label: regroup

items.action: Acrobat rises and feints a charge at the wizard, drawing the next spell.

causes.why: The feint baits the wizard's bolt.

items.label: feint_charge

items.action: Composed again, the wizard sweeps a thin bolt that misses the acrobat and cuts through the bamboo wall.

causes.why: The acrobat flips away from the bolt.

items.label: slicing_bolt

items.action: Acrobat backflips over the bolt's path, body fully inverted at the apex.
items.label: dodge_flip

items.action: Acrobat lands in a crouched guard facing the wizard; the scorch, the crack and the cut bamboo remain.
items.label: land_guard

items.costume: Layered robe with wide sleeves; hood or hat optional.
items.description: A spellcaster who fights from a planted stance and acts through hand gestures and conjured effects.
items.name: wizard
items.silhouette: Tall robed figure; long sleeves and hem hide the legs; often carries a staff.

items.costume: Fitted top and trousers that do not hide the joints; soft shoes or bare feet.
items.description: An agile fighter who moves through vaults, flips and cartwheels and strikes with the legs.
items.name: acrobat
items.silhouette: Lean, compact figure in close-fitting clothes; limbs clearly readable.

items.reads: Weight driving forward over the balls of the feet, knees bending deeper with each stride.
Coiled crouch, weight pitched over the front foot, arms swinging forward for the plant.
Inverted over the planted hand, legs whipping overhead, weight carried by momentum.
Planted wide stance, weight on the back foot, casting arm locked straight ahead.
Dropping toward the stone, knees folding to absorb the landing.
Weight sinks into the left foot as the hips wind up for the spin.
Upright and open, unprepared for the heel coming at the chest.
Balanced on one foot after the kick, the ward catching the chest and lifting the body.
Reeling backward from the kick, both palms forced out to throw the ward.
Flung backward through the air, shoulders rounding to take the impact.
Back pressed to the cracked pillar, legs gathering to push off.
Settling the stance, shoulders dropping as the breath comes back.
Rising out of the crouch, weight leaning in but held back: a feint, not a charge.
Composed, weight centred, casting hand starting to rise toward the acrobat.
Weight rocking onto the heels, reading the bolt and loading for the flip.
Torso turning through the sweep, the casting arm releasing the thin bolt.
Arms swinging up as both feet drive off the stone into the backflip.
Coming down out of the flip, knees bending to land in the guard.
